chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who arrives at the Sacred Monument on the Day of Sacrifice before the decline of the sun, has accomplished the Hajj.

key_terms.يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ: The Day of Sacrifice (8th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for Hajj validity regarding arrival at Muzdalifah?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the critical timing of the Wuquf at Muzdalifah, establishing that reaching Mash'ar al-Haram before solar noon (Zawal) on the 10th of Dhu al-Hijjah is the decisive factor for Hajj validity. In Shia jurisprudence, this highlights the distinction between mere presence and the ritual completion of the station, emphasizing that the sacrifice of time and effort at this specific juncture is integral to the pilgrimage's perfection. It serves as a practical guideline for pilgrims to ensure they do not miss this essential pillar due to delay.
